'''Trinovat''' was a [[Star/Legends|sunny]], [[Plant/Legends|verdant]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Trinovat system/Legends|Trinovat system]]. It was situated in the [[Loop Worlds]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route|hyperlane]] known as the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]] connected it to the [[Durgen's Star system/Legends|Durgen's Star]] and [[Near Indosa system/Legends|Near Indosa systems]]. Trinovat was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Trinovate]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and featured small [[Farm/Legends|farms]] and [[Mining/Legends|mines]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trinovat was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-6.<ref name="TEA" />
